Responsibilities & Key Deliverables:

1. CAN DEVELOPMENT

  • Lead the development and integration of Controller Area Network (CAN) Communication protocol for various automotive applications e.g BMS, CCM, Infotainment system.
  • Design and Implement CAN network configurations, including message scheduling and Bus arbitration.
  • Perform CAN network diagnostics, fault handling and ensure robust communication between ECUs.

2. Basic Software AUTOSAR

  • Develop and maintain AUTOSAR based basic software modules ensuring, compliance with AUTOSAR standards and guidelines.
  • Configure and integrate AUTOSAR BSW stack components, including COM, PDU Router, CanIf, CAN and Diagnostic Event Manager (DEM).
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration of AUTOSAR software components into the overall vehicle architecture.

3. Network Management

  • Design and implement network management strategies for automotive systems, ensuring optimal network performance and reliability.
  • Configure and manage network management protocols, including Startup, Shutdown and Sleep/wake- Up sequences.
  • Perform Network performance analysis and optimization to meet stringent automotive industry standards.
  • Handle Partial Networking to ensure power saving in the network.

4. Requirement Writing

  • Develop detailed software requirements for Level 3 and Level 4 automotive software components, ensuring clarity, completeness and traceability.
  • Collaborate with system engineers and stakeholders to capture and refine requirements, ensuring alignment with overall system architecture and design.
  • Use Doors Next Gen to maintain and track requirements changes and their impact on software development lifecycles.

5. Functional Safety (ISO 26262)

  • Support functional safety activities in accordance with ISO 26262 standards including hazard analysis and risk assessment (HARA).
  • Assist in the development of safety requirements and safety cases for automotive software components.

6. Agile Methodology

  • Actively participate in Agile development processes, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives.
  • Collaborate in a cross-functional agile team to deliver quality software within define sprint cycle.
  • Adapt and respond to changes in project scope and priorities in an Agile environment, ensuring timely delivery of project milestones.

7. V-Model Development

  • Apply V-Model development processes to ensure comprehensive testing and validation at each stage of the software development lifecycle.
  • Develop and execute test cases and validation plans corresponding to each phase of the V-Model, ensuring through verification and validation of software components.
  • Document and trace software requirements and test results, ensuring compliance with the V-Model framework and industry standards.

8. Project Leadership and Collaboration

  • Mentor junior engineers, providing technical guidance and ensuring adherence to best practices and industry standards.
  • Coordinate with cross-functional teams, including hardware, system, and validation engineers, to ensure successful project execution.
  • Participate in project planning, status meetings, and technical reviews, contributing to project risk management and mitigation strategies.

9. Unit Testing and Development

  • Develop and execute unit tests for CAN bus software components, ensuring functionality and performance with respect to design specifications.
  • Debugging and root cause analysis of software problems using Trace 32.
  • Validation of CAN network communication to ensure software robustness.
  • Maintain documentation of test results and debugging activities.

10. Documentation and reporting

  • Prepare and maintain comprehensive documentation for all phases of software development, including design specifications, test plans and user manuals.
  • Generate and present technical reports and progress updates to stakeholders and management.
  • Ensure compliance with industry standards, company policies, and regulatory requirements throughout the software development process.
